noun_definition: web refers to the online platform where users interact with the chat feature and input text using Markdown formatting.

Markdown refers to a lightweight markup language used for formatting text, which in this Issue context is exemplified by the use of the quote syntax (">") to create a quoted message in a chat input field.
Cursor refers to the visual indicator in the text input field that shows the user's current position for typing, which in this case overlaps with certain letters when quote markdown is applied.
Letter refers to a character in the text that is displayed in the description input field, specifically the character "y" in the context of the markdown quote.
Quote markdown refers to a formatting style in which text is prefixed with a ">" symbol to indicate that it is a quotation, as demonstrated by the input "> Hey" in the chat description.
